nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=22 beats='first snow on Maple Hill; Priya age eight and Arun age four stop at the top after one last run; Arun lifts a foot wearing only a soaked sock; the red boot with the peeling yellow star sticker is gone'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='the crossing whistle blows at four and Grandma Nita waits in the blue car; Priya counts three places worth trying, the sled lane below them, the warming hut breathing cocoa steam, and a line of dog prints crossing the fresh snow'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Priya tows the red saucer sled down the packed lane while Arun rides; braided sled tracks cross everywhere; she turns up a striped mitten and a juice lid but no boot'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='at the bottom of the run the gray plow ridge stands taller than Priya on one side and the frozen hay bales sit like hard benches on the other; Arun hops to keep his cold foot off the snow'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Priya chips at the crusted plow ridge with the edge of the saucer sled; a boot toe appears, but it is black and far too big for Arun'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='the ridge runs the whole length of the lane and wet snow slides down inside the sleeve of Priya; down at the gate the plow truck idles with its amber light turning slow; Arun starts to sniffle'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=56 beats='the crust cracks open into a hollow that smells like cold stone; something red shows far back in the dark; Biscuit the crossing dog trots up with his nose working hard and whines to be let at it; the fingers of Priya sting through wet mittens and the hollow is deeper than her whole arm'>>

choices.label: Reach in with your own arm

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='behind the frozen hay bales the wind whistles through a dark gap; Wren tips one bale up with the nose of the long toboggan while straw and old sled wax spill out'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='the warming hut breathes cocoa steam and wet wool; Mrs. Delgado works the plywood counter with a clipboard; a crate of lost things sits under the long bench'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='Mrs. Delgado listens with her pencil stopped and the toes of Arun turn pink beside the stove pipe; she offers to hush the whole hut and call out, or she can let them dig the lost and found crate'>>

choices.label: Ask her to call the hut
Dig through the lost and found

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=22 beats='Mrs. Delgado cups her hands and calls for a small red boot with a yellow star on the heel; two answers come back from the crowded benches'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='one kid saw a red boot hung by its laces on the mitten tree post; another saw the plow driver lift something red at the gate; outside the light goes flat and blue and Arun walks slower and slower'>>

choices.label: Run to the mitten tree post
Catch the driver at the gate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the plow truck idles at the gate with its amber light turning slow; the driver rolls his window down while the four whistle starts up behind them'>>

choices.label: Ask him to check his cab

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the crate holds odd gloves, one ski, a purple boot, and a scarf gone crunchy with ice; Priya digs to the bottom with both arms and a small red toe shows under the scarf'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='paw prints stitch a neat line away from the sled run toward the crossing; Mr. Okafor whistles for Biscuit while holding up his orange sign'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='at a split stump the prints divide, one line heading down to the frozen creek and one heading back to the road where Mr. Okafor stands; Arun tucks his sock foot behind his knee like a heron'>>

choices.label: Take the prints to the creek

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=22 beats='the frozen creek ticks under its skin of ice and the culvert pipe breathes gray air; dry reeds rattle where a tail is swinging'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='Biscuit bursts out of the reeds with something soggy and red in his teeth and starts a game of keep away along the bank; Priya has one granola bar left in her pocket; Arun laughs out loud for the first time all afternoon'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the chase runs down to the creek bend where Biscuit drops the boot in the reeds and Priya lands flat on her elbows in the snow'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='Mr. Okafor remembers a red boot riding down the hill on the nose of a toboggan and hands Priya a pencil stub with a folded sheet of paper'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='the plow driver leans out under his turning amber light and writes the number of Grandma Nita on the back of his glove; no boot tonight; Arun walks to the blue car with a bread bag pulled over his wet sock while the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill; Priya promises him they will be back at nine in the morning'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Biscuit noses deep into the hollow and backs out with the red boot swinging from his teeth; Priya trades him the last granola bar and knocks the packed snow out against the fence post; ice melts off the yellow star all the way to the blue car; Arun stamps the foot down twice to be sure it is really his'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Priya pushes her arm into the hollow up to the elbow and her fingers close on cold rubber; the boot comes out packed hard with snow and the yellow star looks like a little window of ice; she knocks it twice against the fence post to empty it; Arun pulls it on and grins the whole way up the hill'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='under the tipped bale the red boot lies on its side full of straw; Wren holds the bale up with the toboggan while Priya grabs it; Arun shakes the straw out, pulls it on, and they beat the four whistle to the blue car'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='the red boot hangs by knotted laces on the mitten tree post with the star turned out toward the hill; a stranger hung it there for whoever came back for it; Arun pulls it on over the wet sock and Priya ties a double knot; they walk the fence line to the blue car counting frozen mittens'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the driver lifts the red boot off the warm heater vent where he set it that morning; it is dry and toasty inside; Arun shoves his foot in and shouts; Grandma Nita honks the blue car horn twice'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='Priya turns the red boot over and there is the peeling yellow star on the heel; Arun says the star is his proof; Mrs. Delgado crosses a line off her clipboard and holds the hut door open for them'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Biscuit drops the boot for the granola bar and licks the mitten of Priya; the star sticker has curled at one corner but it is stuck fast; Arun hugs the wet boot the whole way up the bank and back across the crossing; they reach the blue car just as the four whistle fades over Maple Hill'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='out of the boot come gravel, cold creek water, and one very surprised beetle; the yellow star is stuck fast to the heel; they run for the gate while the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='no boot today, so Priya draws Maple Hill on the folded paper with the plow ridge, the hay bales, and the culvert pipe marked; Mr. Okafor adds an X where he last saw red; Arun carries the map flat against his chest'>>
